content.stem: 当一家跨国组织制定其反金融犯罪(AFC)计划时,确保在不同司法管辖区合规的最重要考虑因素是什么？

options.A: 确保制裁不会影响到联合国这样的国际机构,因为它们无需遵守当地法律.
options.B: 确保集团政策和程序优先遵循美国法规,因为美国法规在全球范围内最具影响力.
options.C: 应用全球反洗钱和制裁政策,以确保一致性,无需适应当地法规.
options.D: 确保集团政策能够满足各国具体反洗钱和制裁法规的合规要求.

content.stem_en: When a multinational organization develops its anti-financial crime (AFC) program, what is the most important consideration for ensuring compliance across different jurisdictions?

options_en.A: Ensuring sanctions do not impact international bodies like the UN because they are not required to adhere to local laws
options_en.B: Ensuring group policies and procedures prioritize adherence to U.S. regulations because they are the most influential worldwide
options_en.C: Applying global AFC and sanctions policies to ensure consistency without the need to adapt to local regulations
options_en.D: Ensuring group policies cater to compliance with each country's specific AML and sanctions regulations
